<h1>Analytical work should move something.</h1>
<p class="page-lede">I’m Zihui Yao, a UCSD MSBA student with a background in accounting, finance, and applied analytics. I build at the point where AI systems, business questions, and measurable decisions meet.</p>

<div class="about-grid">
<div>
<h2>My working style</h2>
<p>I start with the decision, not the dataset. Then I build the smallest rigorous system that makes that decision faster, clearer, and easier to validate.</p>
<p>My most substantial recent work is a Realtor.com capstone where I helped translate Apple Search Ads performance data into a repeatable, backtest-validated bid decision workflow.</p>
<p>I also bring a finance foundation: financial statement analysis, investment research, risk assessment, and real-estate valuation. That combination helps me ask both technical and commercial questions of an analytical system.</p>
</div>
